data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to set, clear, and query app icon badge counts on iOS, macOS, and Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart API to display numeric badges or a red dot on the app icon, clear the badge, and request the required notification permissions. It abstracts the native badge implementations for iOS, macOS, and Android launchers.
use_when: You need a native app‑icon badge on iOS, macOS, or Android without writing platform code
You want a simple, synchronous check for badge support and a unified API across platforms
avoid_when: Your app runs only on web or desktop platforms that don’t show app‑icon badges
You need custom in‑app notification UI or full notification handling beyond a badge
strengths: Simple, imperative API with no code generation
weaknesses: Android implementation uses a silent notification that may appear in the shade
getBadgeCount is deprecated on iOS and returns only the last set value on Android
data.setup_notes: Add POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission to AndroidManifest for API 33+, call requestPermission() on iOS/macOS as needed; optional Swift Package Manager or CocoaPods for iOS/macOS integration
